description: This file defines a PHP class 'AOS_QuotesViewEdit' that extends the 'ViewEdit' class. It customizes the display method to populate quote templates from the database into a dropdown list, specifically for editing quote views within SuiteCRM.

classes.name: AOS_QuotesViewEdit
classes.description: A class that extends ViewEdit to provide custom display logic for quote editing, including template population.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Overrides the parent display method to populate quote templates before rendering the view.

methods.name: populateQuoteTemplates
methods.description: Fetches template records from 'aos_pdf_templates' table where 'type' is 'AOS_Quotes' and populates the global list for dropdown options.
